high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the user `_space_pirate2.0`. The post features a graphic illustration of Mars with a cross-section showing its internal structure. The title "Marsquakes" is prominently displayed at the top in large, bold white letters against a black background. The graphic depicts Mars as a spherical planet with a visible crust, mantle, and core. The interior layers are color-coded: the outermost layer is light brown, representing the crust; the middle layer is darker brown, indicating the mantle; and the innermost layer is yellow, suggesting the core.
